top_signals.title: Oil Prices Rebound as Middle East Supply Fears Return
top_signals.summary: Crude oil prices, which fell to their lowest in four weeks, staged a rebound earlier today, as traders shifted their attention from the U.S. midterms to the Middle East, awaiting the next step in the war. Benchmarks dropped sharply on Tuesday on reports that Iran may be open to discussions on previously non-negotiable issues, but at the time of writing, Brent crude was trading at $103.60 per barrel, with West Texas Intermediate at $95.98 per barrel, after two energy consultancies warned against too much Gulf oil supply rebound optimism. top_signals.title: Google responds to political backlash over removing search from schools that ban AI
top_signals.summary: After elected officials voiced outrage over Google turning off search at schools that ban AI, the company said search can be turned back on with AI Overviews.
top_signals.why_it_matters: AI and semiconductor developments impacting technology leadership and capex cycles.

top_signals.title: Stocks, Dollar Drop on US Vote; Dip Buyers Emerge: Markets Wrap
top_signals.summary: A Democratic sweep of both houses of Congress rippled across global markets, sending stocks and the dollar lower while boosting Treasuries, on speculation the result will put the brakes on President Donald Trump’s agenda.
